text.tspan: When you're stuck, capture: sudo tcpdump -i any -nn port 5432
Something on the way drops it (SG, NACL,
firewall), or the far end has no route back
Traffic isn't taking this path: DNS gave
a different IP, or a wrong route
Server sends SYN-ACK, client never gets it:
the problem is on the RETURN path
